ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The title at the top of the figure says “THE DIGESTIVE SYSTEM”. The human body diagram labels organs such as oral cavity, pharynx, esophagus, stomach, liver, gallbladder, pancreas, small intestine, large intestine, rectum, anus. Reasoning: These labels are all digestion-related organs, and the title clearly states that the figure represents the digestive system. Therefore, the organ system represented by the figure is the digestive system.
